## Ventures

- [Eduble Startup Inc.](https://eduble.ph): A Filipino edtech startup building affordable learning apps for every learner, from grade school to the board exam and beyond.
- [Reviewlution](https://reviewlution.online): A gamified reviewer for Philippine board exams with timed rounds, streaks, leaderboards, and a projected board rating. 8,700+ users across 557 schools.
